caption:
Caesar Salad: Crisp, Crunchy, and Totally Guilt-Free! 🥗✨

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: (calculated on Myfitnesspal)
C: 34 | F: 10 | P: 43
Calories: 390 per portion 
Makes 2 portions

Ingredients: 
2 chicken breast, slightly pounded,salt and pepper
200 - 300 grams romaine lettuce, you can use a variety here as you prefer
2-3 slices of brown bread, cut into cubes and air fried without any fat 
grated cheese

Caesar’s “cheats” Dressing
1 cup greek yogurt / 160 grams ish 
3-4 garlic cloves, minced
1 tbsp WC sauce
1 tbsp mustard
1/2 tsp salt + 1/2 tsp pepper

Method: 
Pan fry your chicken breast, you can do this without any oil or 1/2 tsp oil as well
season with salt, pepper and cajon seasoning ( optional) but it tastes SO good
once done, set aside and prepare the dressing and croutons 

to make the dressing, combine all the ingredients and set aside

layer the salad
shredded romaine - grilled chicken - croutons - cheese - dressing and voila, your salad is ready :)
